value.rationale: A general incidence-graph condition uniquely determines every Seshadri-computing integral curve, not just the extremal numerical ratio. It identifies the entire null locus of the nef boundary class for all even-line configurations satisfying the explicit hypotheses, with a concrete 38-point F7 blow-up where the class is big of square 26 and has one (-7)-curve as its null locus. This structural equality-rigidity question matters for nef faces and potential contractions; no unproved morphism is claimed.
